alt_texts: Two wild red panda siblings on a mossy branch in Langtang National Park, Nepal, one with its tongue out, headline 'The red panda is not a panda'

Wild red panda looking out from a leafy tree in Sikkim, India, with text on how it was classed with raccoons and then bears
Wild red panda siblings in Langtang National Park with the statistic 1 living member of the family Ailuridae
Captive red panda sitting on a branch among yellow autumn leaves, with text about its pseudo-thumb and bamboo diet
Wild red panda cub perched high in a tree in Langtang National Park, with text on its Endangered status and Himalayan range
Wild red panda in a tree in Sikkim, closing slide with sources and photo credits
